ethnic: An ethnic group is a group related by race, culture, and/or nationality.
The Irish are the largest, but least visible, ethnic minority in Britain.
Characteristic of or belonging to a non-Western cultural tradition, as in ethnic food, costumes and jewelry.
a member of an ethnic minority.
ethical: An ethical issue, problem, etc. relates to questions of good or bad, right or wrong.
Doctors have to think about both the medical and ethical parts of the problem.
If something is ethical, it is good, not bad or wrong. Often, this is based on formal philosophy. Often, what is ethical is based on rules of a group or profession (kind of job).
Is it really ethical to eat meat?
ethics: ; The study of what is good and what is bad, or what should be good and bad. Ethics often is about making rules for how to act, and saying why certain things are bad.
She is studying ethics at the university.
ethic: An ethic is a rule or idea that tells you something is good or bad.
The Protestant work ethic said that people should stay busy and that being lazy was of the Devil.
etymology: Etymology is the study of the history and change of words.
A word's etymology is its history.
ethnicity: A person's ethnicity describes the common characteristics of the cultural group they belong to.
ethereal: Something that is heavenly, unearthly, of the ether (air).
The ballerina had an ethereal aura.
ethos: The character or fundamental values of a person, people, culture, or movement.
A dislike for the ways of the past was part of the ethos of the 1960s.
eternal: If something is eternal, it does not end.
God told men they would have eternal life.
If you say something is eternal, it feels like it lasts too long.
The walk to the classroom in the morning felt eternal.
eternity: Eternity is time with no end.
If something takes an eternity, it takes a very long time.
ethiopia: Ethiopia is a country in Eastern Africa.
ethiopian: An Ethiopian is a person from Ethiopia or of Ethiopian descent.
Something or someone that is Ethiopian comes from Ethiopia.
This cup of Ethiopian coffee has mild floral notes.
etiquette: Etiquette is the forms of polite behavior in society.
etch: If you etch something, you cut into its surface with an acid in order to make a pattern.
etching: Etching is the art of producing an image from a metal plate into which an image or text has been etched with acid.
The piece of art produced by etching.
ethically: If something is done ethically, it is done in a ethical manner.
etymologist: An etymologist is a person who studies the origin of words.
eternally: If you are eternally grateful for something that someone has done, you are grateful for it forever.
eternize: If you eternize something, you make it live or last forever.
eternise: If you eternise something, you make it live or last forever.
ethane: Ethane (C2H6) is a type of hydrocarbon that is found in natural gas.
